resources.string: live wallpaper: sky, sun, moon, clouds, rain and snow
Sunrise Wallpaper 3D is a live wallpaper with dynamic time-of-day changes, weather effects (rain, snow, clouds) and real weather support.

The Sunrise Wallpaper 3D app requests location access only to determine your current location and obtain current weather data.

• We do NOT collect, store, or transfer your location data to third parties.
• Coordinates are used only locally on your device to form an HTTP request to the weather API.
• All data processing happens directly on your device.
• The app contains no trackers, analytics, or ads and does not send any data to developer servers.

If you disable the Real weather feature, location access is no longer required.
